clue.text: Americans lose money initially through growth of store chain

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the three words before it
letters that pass through something end up sitting inside it

rest of WART, a small growth on the skin

explanation.surface: Americans are losing money as a store chain grows.
explanation.walkthrough: The initials ALM go inside WART to make WALMART.
explanation.definitionFit: Walmart is the huge American retail company with stores across the country, an example of a store chain.
